svg.text: Loop round the float: 380 circumference, sewn into a ring with a bar tack

svg.text: Release tab: 80 of webbing folded and sewn to the ring, with a 15 loop at its end

svg.text: The release unit's pin passes through the tab loop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The float's line is tied to the float only, never to the sling or the aircraft

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
